name: The proposition ledger
reader_question: What may change, and where does the evidence stop?
visual_idea: A redline is aligned to its review consequence and missing evidence in an unboxed editorial ledger.
why_geometry_helps: A redline is aligned to its review consequence and missing evidence in an unboxed editorial ledger.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: A neat ledger may imply the review is complete; every consequence is proposed and the evidence gaps remain explicit.
references_used: Supplied Design Board-8: simultaneous source, interpretation and responsibility
Supplied Design System-15: material distinction, authored scale and quiet chrome
what_is_deliberately_not_shown: Detailed chapter text and actual enterprise readiness.
